}}'''Handoin''' is a member of [[the Blood]] and a rival of Empress [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag|Fortuona]] in [[Seanchan (continent)|Seanchan]]. His symbol is a white boar.{{ref/book|14|32}}

== Activities ==
After Empress Fortuona discovers [[Min Farshaw]]'s ability as a [[Doomseer]], she discovers Min's [[Min's viewings|viewing]] about one of her soldiers, who has the sign of the white boar around her. Tuon orders the soldiers to be executed, as she now believes that the woman either works for her rival or will do so in the future. Min asks her to stop, telling the Empress that she will not let her viewings be used in that way, and that people may be watched but should not be harmed until they are caught doing something wrong; the Empress agrees with her.

== Trivia ==
* Handoin is named for Hanne Bergmans, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
